author: Salem Techsperts
description:
It's a shame the average consumer has to deal with the bs associated with DDR5. It's also unfortunate that troubleshooting PC's has become more complicated and time-consuming for repair shops that are already struggling.
Moral of the story, make sure you keep your BIOS updated.
